title: mallotus oppositifolius
intro: Mallotus oppositifolius, commonly known as Kluhkhu or Malay tea tree, is a plant species within the family Euphorbiaceae. It is a medicinal plant native to Southeast Asia, valued for its health benefits and therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Mallotus oppositifolius include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against diseases such as cancer, cardiovascular disease, and neurodegenerative disorders. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties.
